_meta.purpose: EnviroCare Google Ads campaign drafts — content only.
_meta.spend: NONE — these are drafts. No campaign is live and nothing spends until a human explicitly launches it in Google Ads.
_meta.data_basis: Structured from Local Falcon grid scans (7/6/2026) + BrightLocal tracking. Birmingham and Lake Martin already dominate organic local pack (SoLV 78-100%, rank 1-2.6). Huntsville is nearly invisible organically (SoLV 0-11%, rank ~9-11) despite a 5.0 rating on only 28 reviews. Therefore paid budget is weighted to HUNTSVILLE, with Birmingham/Lake Martin run lean/defensive.
_meta.how_to_launch: See agents/ad-launch-plan.md. There is NO live Google Ads API integration in this repo; approving a draft only marks it reviewed. Going live means a human pastes the copy into Google Ads with each campaign set to PAUSED, then flips to ENABLED.
_meta.compliance: All copy validated against data/compliance.ts BANNED_PATTERNS + Google Ads limits. Mosquito copy uses reduce/knock-down only. No safety/availability/discount claims. Tuscaloosa excluded. Services not offered (bed bug/rodent/wildlife) excluded and negatived.
